Game Overview

In Zombie Fortress, the core idea is straightforward: defend your stronghold in a thrilling zombie apocalypse as waves of undead relentlessly attack. Master tactical weapon deployment and use powerful upgrades to outsmart diverse zombie types. Experience the excitement of survival as you strategize, adapt, and conquer in nonstop action-packed battles.
